age.evidence: were 8-16 weeks old at the time of testing

sex.evidence: Male C57BL/6JOlaHsd mice obtained from Envigo (120 animals total) were used for the tests

dosing.evidence: DOI was administered 30 min before start of the tests... All compounds were dissolved in 0.9% (w/v) NaCl... All compounds were administered by intraperitoneal injection in a volume of 10 mL/kg.
8-OH-DPAT and 25CN-NBOH were administered 15 min before start of the tests... All compounds were dissolved in 0.9% (w/v) NaCl... administered by intraperitoneal injection in a volume of 10 mL/kg.

group_housing.evidence: The animals were group housed maximum five mice per cage in individually ventilated cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: The animals were housed on a 12-h light/dark cycle with lights on at 7 a.m. All experiments were conducted in the light phase between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.

assays.assay_description: Transparent type III H cage (42.5×26.5×18 cm) with 20 glass marbles placed in 5×4 pattern on ~5 cm sawdust; 30-min test; buried marbles (>2/3 covered) counted at 10, 20, and 30 min by a treatment-blinded observer.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were administered by intraperitoneal injection in a volume of 10 mL/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were acclimatized to the experimental rooms for at least 1 h before behavioral testing; no apparatus-specific habituation described

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice placed freely in the cage with marbles; no restraint

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

time_to_assay.evidence: DOI was administered 30 min before start of the tests. 8-OH-DPAT and 25CN-NBOH were administered 15 min before start of the tests.

sample_size.evidence: n = 10 (figure legends for Fig. 1 and Fig. 2)

outcomes.summary: Both DOI and 25CN-NBOH dose-dependently reduced compulsive-like digging. DOI 1.0 mg/kg significantly reduced total marbles buried over 30 min; 0.3 and 1.0 mg/kg reduced digging in the first 10 min. 25CN-NBOH 3.0 and 5.0 mg/kg significantly reduced total marbles buried.
outcomes.evidence: 1.0 mg/kg DOI significantly reduced compulsive-like digging (p < 0.0001) during 30 min... 3.0 (p = 0.0149) and 5.0 mg/kg (p = 0.0214) 25CN-NBOH significantly reduced compulsive-like digging during 30 min

B1_num_measures.evidence: Counted marbles at 10, 20, 30 min plus total — single behavioural variable (marbles buried) at multiple time bins

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The number of marbles buried within 10-min time bins were analyzed by two-way repeated measures ANOVA with treatment as independent factor and time as repeated factor

B4_ethological.evidence: Digging is a natural ethological behaviour from the species' repertoire (compulsive-like digging in the marble burying test)

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually with no social construct

B6_cognitive.evidence: Test does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: A treatment-blinded observer counted the visible marbles

E1_environment_type.evidence: transparent type III H cages (L x W x H: 42.5 × 26.5 × 18 cm)

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the test apparatus

E5_enrichment.evidence: Marbles are test stimuli, not enrichment

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single test day per animal for MB

assays.assay_description: Non-baited three-armed Y-maze (40 × 7 cm) under red light; 10-min test; arm entry series recorded by treatment-blinded observer; alternation ratio = correct alternations/(total arm visits - 2). Tested alone and combined with 8-OH-DPAT.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were administered by intraperitoneal injection in a volume of 10 mL/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Room acclimation described; no apparatus habituation specified

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

time_to_assay.evidence: DOI was administered 30 min before start of the tests. 8-OH-DPAT and 25CN-NBOH were administered 15 min before start of the tests.

sample_size.evidence: n = 8-12 (figure legends for Fig. 3 and Fig. 4)

outcomes.summary: 8-OH-DPAT reduced alternation ratio. DOI alone significantly decreased alternation at 0.1, 0.3, 1.0 mg/kg, but 0.3 and 1.0 mg/kg DOI reversed the 8-OH-DPAT-induced deficit. 25CN-NBOH alone had no effect; 3.0 mg/kg partially reversed the 8-OH-DPAT-induced deficit.
outcomes.statistics: DOI × 8-OH-DPAT interaction: F3,76 = 6.46, p = 0.0006; 8-OH-DPAT main effect: F1,76 = 19.33, p < 0.0001; 25CN-NBOH × 8-OH-DPAT: F3,76 = 1.37, p = 0.2598; 3.0 mg/kg 25CN-NBOH+8-OH-DPAT vs VEH+8-OH-DPAT p = 0.0385
outcomes.evidence: DOI alone significantly reduced alternation ratio at 0.1 (p = 0.0052), 0.3 (p = 0.0006) and 1.0 mg/kg (p = 0.0169)... 3.0 mg/kg 25CN-NBOH significantly reversed the 8-OH-DPAT-induced reduction in alternation ratio (p = 0.0385)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Alternation ratio and total number of arm visits

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single 10-min ratio reported, no within-session time-binning

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: A treatment-blinded observer recorded the series and number of entries... correct alternation when they visited three consecutive different arms — sequential structure of arm entries is analyzed

B4_ethological.evidence: Spatial arm entries scored, not ethological behaviours

B6_cognitive.evidence: Spontaneous alternation requires working memory/spatial cognition

B7_automated_classification.evidence: A treatment-blinded observer recorded the series and number of entries

E3_bedding.evidence: Maze cleaned with water and paper towels; no bedding mentioned

E6_spatial.evidence: Three-armed Y-maze with physically distinct arms

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single test day per animal for SAB

assays.assay_description: Transparent type III H cages (42.5×26.5×18 cm); 30-min recording in 5-min time bins via EthoVision XT video tracking; distance traveled measured.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were administered by intraperitoneal injection in a volume of 10 mL/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were not acclimatized to the test cages, and the recording was started immediately after placing the animals in the test cages

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals freely moving in test cages

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

time_to_assay.evidence: 25CN-NBOH were administered 15 min before start of the tests

outcomes.summary: 25CN-NBOH dose-dependently increased locomotor activity. 3.0 mg/kg significantly increased total distance traveled and activity at 5, 10, 15, and 25 min; 5.0 mg/kg increased activity at 5, 10, and 15 min.
outcomes.statistics: Total distance: F3,36 = 2.60, p = 0.0672; 3.0 mg/kg pairwise p = 0.0120; time-bin treatment effect F3,36 = 3.00, p = 0.0433
outcomes.evidence: 3.0 mg/kg 25CN-NBOH significantly increased locomotor activity at 5 (p = 0.0031), 10 (p = 0.0013), 15 (p = 0.0055), and 25 (p = 0.0375) minutes

B1_num_measures.evidence: Distance traveled served as a measure of LA (single behavioural variable; time bins are temporal sub-divisions of one measure)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Movement was recorded for 30 min in 5-min time bins... analyzed by two-way RM ANOVA with treatment as independent factor and time as repeated factor

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance only, no ethological behaviours scored

B7_automated_classification.evidence: EthoVision XT — position tracking only, not behavioural classification

E1_environment_type.evidence: transparent type III H cages (42.5 × 26.5 × 18 cm) on a white background

E3_bedding.evidence: Placed on a white background; no bedding mentioned for LA test

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single test day per animal for LA

assays.assay_description: Y-maze adapted with plexiglass doors to separate runway arm, familiar arm, and novel arm. Mice exposed to familiar arm for 5 min, then novel arm opened and time spent in each arm recorded for 2 min by a blinded observer. Discrimination index calculated. Used to assess effects of 8-OH-DPAT on spatial attention; DOI/25CN-NBOH were not directly administered in this assay.

application_type.evidence: All compounds were administered by intraperitoneal injection (8-OH-DPAT only in this assay)

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

time_to_assay.evidence: 8-OH-DPAT was administered 15 min before start of the tests

outcomes.summary: 8-OH-DPAT did not significantly affect time spent in the novel vs. familiar arm or the discrimination index, indicating intact spatial attention. Both vehicle and 8-OH-DPAT animals spent more time in the novel arm.
outcomes.statistics: Treatment: F1,16 = 2.87, p = 0.1097; Treatment × arm interaction: F1,16 = 0.12, p = 0.7357; arm main effect F1,16 = 13.42, p = 0.0021; discrimination index t16 = 0.52, p = 0.6108
outcomes.evidence: 8-OH-DPAT did not affect V-maze performance, supporting that the decrease in alternation ratio in the SAB test is not due to a deficit in spatial attention.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Time in novel arm, time in familiar arm, discrimination index

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total time over 2 min reported, no within-session bins

B4_ethological.evidence: Time in zones scored, not ethological behaviours

B6_cognitive.evidence: Novel vs familiar arm preference requires memory of familiar arm

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Time recorded by a treatment-blinded observer

E6_spatial.evidence: Runway arm, familiar arm, novel arm separated by plexiglass doors

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were not available during experiments

D1_continuity.evidence: 5-min familiar arm exposure followed by 2-min novel arm recording — two recording phases within the assay

judge_notes: Included the V-maze test as a separate assay because it is a distinct behavioural paradigm with a different apparatus configuration and outcome (spatial attention/discrimination); only gptoss-style minimal candidates omitted it. 8-OH-DPAT (the directly tested compound) is not a psychedelic, but the assay belongs to the same study design supporting the SAB interpretation and is described as a behavioural assay in animals exposed to drug; kept for completeness.

B1 (number of measures): MB test scored 1 ('2-3') — marbles buried at three time bins are sub-scores of the same measure. SAB scored 1 (alternation ratio + total arm visits). LA scored 0 (single measure: distance traveled).
B4 (ethological): MB scored Yes (digging is in the species' natural repertoire per rubric). SAB and LA scored No.
Dropped 1.5 mg/kg from 25CN-NBOH dose list (mentioned only as a literature reference to Buchborn 2018, not administered in this study).
Reconciled time_to_assay: for assays with both DOI (30 min) and 25CN-NBOH (15 min), used 30 min as primary value (still acute_0to2h bin).
Reconciled n_total: MB = 40 (4 groups × n=10), SAB = 80 (8 groups × ~10), LA = 40, V-maze = 18.
